details:
This update for amazon-ssm-agent fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-47913: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/agent: client process termination when receiving an unexpected message type
  in response to a key listing or signing request (bsc#1253611).
- CVE-2025-47914: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/agent: missing validation of message sizes when processing new identity
  requests can cause a panic due to an out-of-bounds read (bsc#1254082).
- CVE-2025-58181: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: missing validation of number of mechanisms specified in a request can cause
  unbounded memory consumption (bsc#1253946).
- CVE-2026-56854,CVE-2026-56855,CVE-2026-78662: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: authentication bypass and deadlocks in the
  crypto/ssh library (bsc#1278681).
- CVE-2026-78663: golang.org/x/net/http2: double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server streams allows for flow control
  limit bypass (bsc#1288254).
- CVE-2026-97032: golang.org/x/net/http2: HPACK encoder race can lead to HTTP/2 server crash (bsc#1288255).

Changes for amazon-ssm-agent:

- Update to version 3.3.5708.0
  * Send bucket-owner header on s3 http/https fallback
  * Only write serial port messages when running in EC2
  * Apply IMDS retry bound in fallback config path
  * Harden input validation for Linux domain join parameters
  * Add multicloud support enabling SSM Agent registration with GCP
  * Add sqv fallthrough for setupcli when gpg is not installed
- Update to version 3.3.5678.0
  * Bump golang.org/x/sys from v0.47.0 to v0.48.0
  * Bump golang.org/x/net from v0.57.0 to v0.60.0
  * Upgrade Go version to 1.26.10
- Raise minimum Go version to 1.26.10 in BuildRequires
- Update to version 3.3.5538.0
  * Bug fixes for aws-sdk-go-v2
  * Upgrade Go version to 1.26.9
- Raise minimum Go version to 1.26.9 in BuildRequires
- Update to version 3.3.5390.0
  * Bump github.com/gorilla/websocket from v1.4.2 to v1.5.3
  * Bump golang.org/x/crypto from v0.53.0 to v0.56.0
  * Bump golang.org/x/net from v0.56.0 to v0.57.0
  * Bump golang.org/x/sys from v0.46.0 to v0.47.0
  * Upgrade GoLang version from 1.25 to 1.26
  * Mint control-channel token after dial to fix AZ-fault token expiry
  * Resume patch documents interrupted by an external shutdown
  * Use systemctl for systemd in aws: configureDocker on Amazon Linux
  * Update greengrass component version to 1.3.5
